novel_features.name: Offline Library
novel_features.description: Mirror bookmarks, collections, tags and highlights for instant offline search.
novel_features.rationale: Requires durable checkpoints, snapshots and FTS5 indexes across paginated API resources.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before local analysis or when repeated remote scans would waste rate limit.

novel_features.name: Inbox Review
novel_features.description: Process Unsorted bookmarks in resumable, bounded review sessions.
novel_features.rationale: Requires durable item lifecycle and confirmed per-item writeback.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for safe inbox-zero organization without repeated prompts.

novel_features.name: Change History
novel_features.description: Show field-level bookmark changes between sync snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Raindrop exposes current state but not durable before-and-after history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to audit automation and discover recent library edits.

novel_features.name: Tag Health
novel_features.description: Discover case variants, near-duplicates, singleton tags and merge candidates.
novel_features.rationale: Requires whole-library joins, normalization and co-occurrence statistics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before bulk tag cleanup instead of guessing merge targets.

novel_features.name: Duplicate Plans
novel_features.description: Choose canonical bookmarks while preserving tags, notes and highlights.
novel_features.rationale: Requires normalized URL groups and persistent reviewable mutation plans.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when duplicate cleanup must not discard richer metadata.

novel_features.name: Revisit Queue
novel_features.description: Resurface useful forgotten bookmarks without repeating recent suggestions.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local history, scoring and prior-resurfacing state.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to turn a bookmark archive back into an active reading system.

novel_features.name: Related Bookmarks
novel_features.description: Find explainable related bookmarks offline using text, tags and domains.
novel_features.rationale: Requires FTS5 BM25 plus local tag-overlap joins across the mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for research synthesis without a hosted semantic-search dependency.

novel_features.name: Highlight Digests
novel_features.description: Create deduplicated Markdown or JSONL study digests from highlights.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local joins and export cursors across bookmarks and highlights.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to turn annotations into portable research output.

novel_features.name: Durable Triage
novel_features.description: Run crash-safe bounded triage queues with retry and manual-review states.
novel_features.rationale: Requires atomic claims, unique enqueue constraints and persistent lifecycle receipts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for unattended agents that must resume safely after failures.

narrative.headline: Complete Raindrop.io control plus offline search, safe cleanup, and durable knowledge workflows.
narrative.value_prop: Use every documented bookmark, collection, tag, highlight, file, import, export and backup operation from one Go CLI. SQLite sync powers historical diffs, resumable review, explainable related-bookmark search and crash-safe automation while the matching MCP server exposes the same command tree to agents.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set RAINDROP_TOKEN, run `raindrop auth set-token`, or place a test token in `.raindrop-token`. Tokens are sent only as `Authorization: Bearer` to api.raindrop.io and are never written into output artifacts.

quickstart.comment: Check config, storage and command wiring without credentials.
Inspect local mirror freshness before network access.

troubleshoots.fix: Refresh test token at https://app.raindrop.io/settings/integrations and update RAINDROP_TOKEN.
Let built-in Retry-After backoff finish or reduce sync page concurrency.
Run `raindrop sync` and inspect `raindrop sync status`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for scripted or agent-driven Raindrop.io management, offline retrieval, safe bulk cleanup, highlight workflows, and resumable library organization. Prefer local commands when historical state or deterministic automation matters.
anti_triggers: Do not use for browser-extension UI interactions.
Do not use destructive apply commands without reviewing their dry-run plans.
Do not use local search when current remote state is required and sync is stale.
